class.name: IfcTransportElement
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : Generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a building or building complex. The IfcTransportElement defines the occurrence of a transport element, that (if given), is expressed by the IfcTransportElementType . EXAMPLE Transportation elements include elevator (lift), escalator, moving walkway, etc. NOTE More detailed equipment that

members.member: Predefined generic types for a transportation element that are specified in an enumeration. There might be property sets defined specifically for each predefined type. IFC2x4 CHANGE The attribute has been changed to be optional. In IFC2X3 files, this is the [code]OperationType[/code] attribute. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.
Capacity of the transport element measured by weight. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Capacity of the transportation element measured in numbers of person. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it is empty.
